title: ShipSector - My space factorio game of my dreams.
author: ShipSector
selftext:
Since like 2 weeks i have claude running 24/7 working on this factorio space game.

You just build a factory and mining operation in space, explore with the resources you mine and go to war! You are able to build not only one ship... you are free to make as much ships as you want, automate them and do stuff you want to!

Whats your opinion on such a game? Any ideas/feedback?

  
Here is the trailer: [https://www.tiktok.com/@shipsector/video/7672433566835379458](https://www.tiktok.com/@shipsector/video/7672433566835379458)

comments.author: octaviustf
comments.body: i watched your trailer and this looks pretty cool NGL- maybe make a web demo for people to try out?

replies.author: ShipSector
replies.body:
It was public for my friends and interesed people before i made this public.

I feel like i need to polish that game and ingest some feedback of the people.

This game is in a realy early stage. The base concept works but i dont know where this will be go. I fully designed it as MMO factorio in space but this will cost a lot of servers.... But its already working tbh. 

The other way would be make it singleplayer focuses/coop focused. It would be much easier for the software to handle. Simulating big big factories is hard in mmo :/

replies.author: octaviustf
replies.body: Ya you’d have to turn off or toggle PVP - I think a 4 player coop could be cool - much easier scope

replies.author: ShipSector
replies.body:
That would be my "singleplayer/multiplayer coop" scope. Thats already done but in my dream this must be bigger

See that glitched out warp portal (the blue line) in the video? You can build that this is not scripted I want players to work on the whole world.... That would work nice for such a game. You just need to be 10000000000 miles outside of everything.

comments.author: octaviustf
comments.body: Ya sounds cool. If you had some kind of universal resource marketplace or something where players could focus on making rare materials and sell them? Not sure

comments.body: Is this perhaps similar to star sonata 2?
